attempt: The unit says CONTINUE (level 1 Nucleus) indicates no executable statement is present AND causes an implicit transfer of control to the next executable statement, unconditionally; I tried to show the transfer half (or its unconditional form, or the level/module) is stated by none of the four rows.
reason: Each id exists. VI.6.9.1 p1 says no executable statement is present; VI.6.9.4 GR1 says no effect on execution, so control flow is the general mechanism. IV.4.4.2 p1 states that mechanism (statement to statement, "is an implicit transfer of control"), and p5 defines next executable statement as where control goes by the rules above and each element's rules. The unit adds no case: its unconditional wording is a summary and overrides nothing in IV.4.4.2 on there being no next executable statement. Level 1 NUC matches the rows (module Nucleus, level 1). Its 1985-new-feature status is an edition fact, not an obligation.
quoted: the next COBOL statement to which control is transferred
